mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_behavior (user_id, article_id, behavior_type, target) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{behaviorType}, #{target})
mapper.select: SELECT article_id FROM ( SELECT article_id, SUM(weight) AS w FROM ( SELECT article_id, CASE behavior_type WHEN 'VIEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'LIKE' THEN 3 WHEN 'COLLECT' THEN 3 WHEN 'SHARE' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END AS weight FROM article_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since} ) t GROUP BY article_id ORDER BY w DESC, article_id LIMIT #{limit} ) x
